cats.name: 橘猫
cats.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: SIX KEYFRAME character design sheet for BitCat desktop pet. Reference image is STYLE GUIDANCE ONLY: follow its authored retro pixel-art aesthetic, calm feline personality, clear silhouette and natural seated anatomy, but create the DIFFERENT CAT described below. Exactly SIX full-body cats of the SAME identity arranged in a regular THREE COLUMNS by TWO ROWS grid. Landscape canvas 3:2 aspect ratio, equal square cells, transparent alpha background. Each cat fully inside its cell, generous 12 percent padding, no overlap or cropping. Consistent scale, palette, markings and character proportions across all frames. Flat limited color pixel clusters, hard square stepped edges, around 12 colors, roughly 48x48 logical-pixel detail per cell enlarged crisply. No gradients, no smooth shading, no fine texture, no text, no numbers, no grid lines, no scenery, no floor, no shadows, no props, no symbols, no extra limbs.
Exact row-major six KEY POSES:
1 top-left: seated neutral idle, three-quarter front facing slightly LEFT, eyes open, tail resting or curving beside body.
2 top-middle: EXACT same seated pose and alignment as frame 1, BOTH eyes gently fully closed in a blink, mouth neutral, no amber/blue/green visible.
3 top-right: full-body WALK key pose A, SIDE VIEW facing LEFT, actual four-legged walking anatomy, left foreleg forward and left hindleg back, opposite legs alternate, tail extended for balance.
4 bottom-left: full-body WALK key pose B, SAME side-view body orientation and scale as frame 3, opposite stride phase, left foreleg back and left hindleg forward. Clearly different leg pose, no extra legs.
5 bottom-middle: sleeping fully curled on ground, head tucked near paws, eyes closed, tail wrapped around body. Natural horizontal silhouette, NOT sitting with a sleep symbol.
6 bottom-right: happy greeting, seated with one front paw raised, eyes softly smiling, relaxed ears, retain feline anatomy, no hearts or sparkles.
These are designed KEYFRAMES not a completed tweened animation; prioritize recognizability and readable varied anatomy.
CAT DESIGN: Ginger domestic shorthair: compact friendly body, warm orange coat, dark ginger broad tabby stripes, cream muzzle chest and front toes, amber eyes. Curious friendly upright ears. Modestly plump belly.
